class.name: AbilitySystemDebugger
class.brief_description: In-game overlay for the ability system.
class.description: Shows one [AbilitySystemComponent] at a time: attributes (base and current, modified ones highlighted), owned tags with their counts, tags blocking abilities, active effects with time left, stacks and granted tags, granted abilities with their state, cooldown and the reason of the last refused activation, active gameplay cues, and a short log of what just happened - activations, refusals, effects added and removed, tag changes, cues. In debug builds the [World] adds one under the root as [code]AbilitySystemDebugger[/code], unless [code]application/game_framework/debug/gas_debugger[/code] is [code]false[/code]. It starts hidden and is driven from the console: [code]gas.toggle [on|off][/code] shows or hides it, [code]gas.next[/code] steps through every component in the tree, [code]gas.target self|<node path>[/code] picks one. There are no keys by default; set [member toggle_action] and [member cycle_action] to Input Map actions to add some. It starts on the local player's pawn. On a client it shows the replicated mirror - exactly what helps when a client "does not see" a tag or an effect the server has.

method.name: cycle_target
method.description: Shows the next [AbilitySystemComponent] in the tree.

method.name: describe
method.description: The overlay's text (BBCode) for [param component]. Usable without showing the overlay, e.g. to print a component's state from a test.

method.name: format_snapshot
method.description: The attribute, tag, effect, ability and cue sections (BBCode) of an [method AbilitySystemComponent.get_debug_snapshot] dictionary. The gameplay debugger's Abilities category uses it too.

method.name: set_target
method.description: Shows [param component] and starts a fresh event log for it.

members.member: Input action that steps to the next component while the overlay is shown.
How many recent events the log keeps.
Input action that shows and hides the overlay.
